URL: https://www.reuters.com/world/china/chinas-xi-talks-economy-taiwan-reception-marking-national-day-2026-09-30/
Reuters — "China's Xi talks economy, Taiwan at reception marking National Day". Dateline BEIJING, Sept 30 (Reuters). Published 30 September 2026, 11:23 UTC (12:23 BST). CONFIRMED 30 Sep.
URL copied verbatim from the Exa search result (not typed from memory). reuters.com 403s on WebFetch, so body below is Exa's snippet of the article's own words, cross-checked against the identical Reuters wire copy carried by The Straits Times and Investing.com.

BODY (verbatim as returned):
"BEIJING, Sept 30 (Reuters) - Chinese President Xi Jinping on Wednesday called for efforts to achieve full-year economic targets while reiterating firm opposition to Taiwan independence and external interference, according to a speech he delivered at a reception marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic."

XI JINPING (President of the People's Republic of China), verbatim:
"We should ... deepen cross-Strait exchanges and cooperation, resolutely combat separatist forces advocating Taiwan independence, and oppose interference by external forces."
And China should "promote the peaceful development of cross-Strait relations and advance the great cause of national reunification."

CONTEXT FROM THE SAME WIRE:
- Reuters photo caption: "Chinese President Xi Jinping attends the National Day reception alongside Premier Li Qiang and National People's Congress (NPC) Standing Committee Chairman Zhao Leji, on the eve of the 77th founding anniversary of the People's Republic of China, at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing, China September 30, 2026. REUTERS/Florence Lo/Pool"
- "Xi routinely attends the annual reception held on the eve of China's October 1 National Day and has often delivered an address there."

ALTERNATIVE WORDING OF THE SAME XI QUOTE, from the AFP translation of the same speech (AFP is an approved domain but the carrier I found it on, Borneo Post, is NOT approved — use the Reuters wording above unless an approved AFP carrier is found):
"We must deepen cross-Strait exchanges and cooperation, resolutely crack down on 'Taiwan independence' separatist forces, oppose interference from external forces, promote the peaceful development of cross-Strait relations, and advance the great cause of national reunification."
